verdict.rationale: MoonPay is an API platform, so API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question to ask. The evidence documents an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, SDKs and endpoints, but never mentions API versioning, version pinning, or a deprecation or sunset policy. An OpenAPI spec alone does not show versioned APIs or a deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
